name: MOP_IMP_PROMOTIONS
description: This is the interface table for migrating promotions from an external data source into fusion. This interface table is also used to store multi-lingual attributes. This is a single interface table that will be used to migrate  data into the following promotion base tables in fusion - MOP_PROMOTIONS_B and MOP_PROMOTIONS_TL. The WHO columns in this table, just reflects when the data was loaded into the interface table or when it was processed. These columns are for information purpose only and will not be used during actual import into Fusion.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Batch Identifier. Identifier that groups data into a batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Interface Row Id. Will be used to link this row with rows in the error table.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the row to be processed.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: For internal use. Used to evaluate the operation to be performed on a row such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: PROMOTION_ID
columns.description: Used for internal processing. Promotion Identifier in fusion.

columns.name: PROMOTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the Promotion. It can be in one of the following: Active, Inactive or InProgress.

columns.name: PROMOTION_NUM
columns.description: Unique Promotion Number

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date of the promotion. Date from which the promotion is effective.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the promotion. Date from which the promotion is not effective.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: SOURCE_LANG_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether the specified language is also the source language.

columns.name: PROMOTION_NAME
columns.description: Translated Name of the Promotion

columns.name: PROMOTION_DESC
columns.description: Translated Promotion Description

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by the file import wizard to relate a row in the interface table to the actual data file that was uploaded.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
